(function() {
const CS_CONFIG = {
id: 'e822d16d73821',
siteKey: 'space',
subsets: [{"conditions":{"path":"\/"},"sampleRate":1,"sessionTracking":true}],
sessionStorageKey: 'cs_session_space'
};
const hasSessionFlag = () => {
return sessionStorage.getItem(CS_CONFIG.sessionStorageKey) === 'true';
};
const setSessionFlag = () => {
sessionStorage.setItem(CS_CONFIG.sessionStorageKey, 'true');
};
/**
* Checks if the current page matches a subset's conditions.
* Matches can be based on URL path or article ID.
*/
const matchesSubset = (subset) => {
const currentArticleId = null;
// Check if path condition matches current URL pathname
if (subset.conditions.path && window.location.pathname === subset.conditions.path) {
return true;
}
// Check if articleId condition matches current article ID
if (subset.conditions.articleId && currentArticleId) {
const articleIds = Array.isArray(subset.conditions.articleId) ? subset.conditions.articleId : [subset.conditions.articleId];
return articleIds.includes(currentArticleId);
}
return false;
};
const isInSample = (subset, subsetIndex) => {
const sampleRate = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, subset.sampleRate || 1));
const storageKey = `cs_sample_${CS_CONFIG.siteKey}_${subsetIndex}`;
const persistedSample = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
if (persistedSample) {
return persistedSample === 'true';
}
// Determine if user is in sample based on random chance and sample rate
// Store the decision in localStorage for future page loads
const isSampled = Math.random() * 100 <= sampleRate;
localStorage.setItem(storageKey, isSampled ? 'true' : 'false');
return isSampled;
};
const initContentSquare = (isInitialLoad = false) => {
if (!Array.isArray(window._uxa)) {
window._uxa = [];
}
// Build the path with hash converted to query parameter format
const path = `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.hash.replace('#', '?__')}`;

mt.src = `//t.contentsquare.net/uxa/${CS_CONFIG.id}.js`;
document.getElementsByTagName("head")[0].appendChild(mt);
}
};
const checkAndInitCS = () => {
if (hasSessionFlag()) {
initContentSquare(false);
return;
}
const matchedIndex = CS_CONFIG.subsets.findIndex((subset, index) =>
matchesSubset(subset) && isInSample(subset, index)
);
if (matchedIndex !== -1) {
const subset = CS_CONFIG.subsets[matchedIndex];
// Set session flag only if sessionTracking is enabled for this subset
// This flag will persist for the browser tab session and enable tracking on all pages
if (subset.sessionTracking) {
setSessionFlag();
}
initContentSquare(true);
return;
}
};
checkAndInitCS();
window.initContentSquare = checkAndInitCS;
})();

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

}

function getCookieValueBis(name) {
const v = document.cookie.match('(^|;) ?' + name + '=([^;]*)(;|$)');
return v ? v[2] : null;
}
function submitRedirection() {
sessionStorage.setItem('membership_just_signed_up', 'true');
window.location.href = '/membership';

emailInput.addEventListener('focus', () => { isInputFocused = true; });

if(window.dispatchOrQueueAction) {
window.dispatchOrQueueAction('freyr.sendEventToFreyr', {
name: 'membershipEvent',
eventObject: { membership: { action: "input-signup-form", label: "user-personal-data", type: "banner-sticky" } }
});
}
});
}
if (formElement) {
formElement.addEventListener("submit", async function (event) {
event.preventDefault();
if (!emailInput.value.trim()) { emailInput.focus(); return; }
if (isLoginMode) {
if (window.FUTR?.Connect?.Auth?.login) {
window.FUTR.Connect.Auth.login();
submitRedirection();

}
submitBtn.disabled = true;
if(window.dispatchOrQueueAction) {
window.dispatchOrQueueAction('freyr.sendEventToFreyr', {
name: 'membershipEvent',
eventObject: { membership: { action: "signup-form-submit", label: 'user-personal-data', type: "hero-banner" } }
});
}
const formData = new FormData(this);
let jsonData = { submission: {} };
const kiosqId = window.FUTR?.Kiosq?.User?.sub ?? null;
const gaId = getCookieValueBis('_ga');
const hybridId = (window.bordeaux?.hybridId) || getCookieValueBis('h_id');
const blueconicId = (window.blueConicClient?.profile?.getProfile()?.getId()) || getCookieValueBis('BCSessionID');
const userIds = [
{ type: 'TYPE_KIOSQ', value: kiosqId },
{ type: 'TYPE_GA', value: gaId },
{ type: 'TYPE_HYBRID', value: hybridId },
{ type: 'TYPE_BLUECONIC', value: blueconicId}
].filter((id) => id.value && typeof id.value === 'string');

</div>
</div>`;
}
})
.catch(error => {
console.error("Submission failed", error);
submitBtn.disabled = false;
});
});

function updateBannerPosition() {
if (!banner || !bannerVisible) return;
const topObstacles = [
document.querySelector('.dfp-leaderboard-container [style*="position: fixed"]'),
document.querySelector('.dfp-leaderboard-container [id^="bordeaux-ad-"]'),
document.querySelector('.dfp-leaderboard-container'),
document.querySelector('[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead"]'),
document.querySelector('nav.primary-nav'),
document.querySelector('.navigation__container')
];
let maxBottomOffset = 0;
topObstacles.forEach(el => {
if (el) {
const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
const isVisible = style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden';
if (isVisible && rect.height > 0 && rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < 300) {
maxBottomOffset = Math.max(maxBottomOffset, rect.bottom);
}
}
});
banner.style.top = `${Math.max(0, maxBottomOffset)}px`;
banner.style.marginTop = '0px';
}
const triggerInstantUpdate = () => {
if (bannerVisible) {
window.requestAnimationFrame(updateBannerPosition);
}
};
const adContainer = document.querySelector('.dfp-leaderboard-container');
const headerContainer = document.querySelector('[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead"]');
if (adContainer || headerContainer) {
const instantObserver = new MutationObserver(triggerInstantUpdate);
const observerConfig = {
childList: true,
subtree: true,
attributes: true,
attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
};
if (adContainer) instantObserver.observe(adContainer, observerConfig);
if (headerContainer) instantObserver.observe(headerContainer, observerConfig);
}
const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(triggerInstantUpdate);
resizeObserver.observe(document.body);
resizeObserver.observe(document.documentElement);
function showBanner() {
if (window.scrollY < 100) return;
const heroComponent = document.getElementById('full-bleed-hero');
if (heroComponent && heroComponent.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > 0) return;
if(typeof ffte !== 'undefined' && ffte?.properties?.articleType === 'deals') return;
if (!bannerDismissed && !isAuthKiosq && !isAuthConnect) {
if(window.dispatchOrQueueAction) {
window.dispatchOrQueueAction('freyr.sendEventToFreyr', {
name: 'membershipEvent',
eventObject: { membership: { action: "scroll-page", label: "membership-banner", type: "banner-sticky" } }
});
}
const bgImg = document.getElementById('skinnyBannerBgImg');
if (bgImg && !bgImg.getAttribute('src')) {
if (bgImg.getAttribute('data-srcset')) bgImg.setAttribute('srcset', bgImg.getAttribute('data-srcset'));
bgImg.setAttribute('src', bgImg.getAttribute('data-src'));
}
banner.classList.add('show');
document.body.classList.add('banner-visible');
bannerVisible = true;
updateBannerPosition();
}
}
function hideBanner() {
if (isInputFocused) return;
banner.classList.remove('show');
bannerVisible = false;
bannerExpanded = false;
banner.classList.remove('expanded');
document.body.classList.remove('banner-expanded');
banner.style.top = '';
banner.style.marginTop = '';
}
function toggleBanner() {
if (bannerDismissed) return;
bannerExpanded = !bannerExpanded;
banner.classList.toggle('expanded', bannerExpanded);
document.body.classList.toggle('banner-expanded', bannerExpanded);
if (bannerExpanded && window.dispatchOrQueueAction) {
window.dispatchOrQueueAction('freyr.sendEventToFreyr', {
name: 'membershipEvent',
eventObject: { membership: { action: "click-banner", label: "membership-banner", type: "banner-sticky" } }
});
}
}
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
const heroComponent = document.getElementById('full-bleed-hero');
const isHeroVisible = heroComponent && heroComponent.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > 0;
if (isHeroVisible || window.scrollY < 100) {
if (!isInputFocused) hideBanner();
} else {
if (!bannerVisible) showBanner();
}
if (bannerVisible) triggerInstantUpdate();
}, { passive: true });
window.addEventListener('resize', triggerInstantUpdate, { passive: true });
document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
if (!banner) return;
if (!banner.contains(event.target) && banner.classList.contains('expanded') && document.body.classList.contains('banner-expanded')) {
toggleBanner();
}
});
if (bannerHeader) bannerHeader.addEventListener('click', toggleBanner);
if (joinNowBtn) joinNowBtn.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); window.location.href = '/membership'; });
});
</script>
